svg.title: HYDRA-130 chip package projection
svg.desc: An illustrated package for the SkyWater 130 OpenFrame chip with all 44 pads labelled from the RTL: pad 0 clock, 1 reset, 2 connect strap, 3 to 10 tile inputs, 11 to 18 tile outputs, 19 to 26 bidirectional, the rest unused. Not a layout.
svg.text: HYDRA-130 on SkyWater 130 nm — the chip after tapeout (projection)
Every one of the 44 OpenFrame pads, labelled from sky130/rtl/hydra_openframe_top.sv and the tile's info.yaml. Illustration only: not hardened, no package chosen.
engines: not yet on the chip
PAD SIGNAL WHAT IT IS FOR
Reset leaves every pad an input.
